no-reader:tt-b.title: Nobody reads → top
no-reader:tt-b.message: top → publishes to → top, but nothing consumes it: it keeps every message, unread.
no-reader:tt-b.rationale: A topic keeps what's published until its retention ends, whether anything reads it or not. With no consumer group, nothing acts on its messages, and more partitions don't change that.

fix.label: Add a consumer…
fix.choice: Pick what reads → top, then add it and connect tt-b to it.
